 SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 Out, Download Hall Ticket
 The SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 was released on 12 November 2026. Candidates shortlisted for the physical tests can download their hall tickets online. The PET/PST will be conducted from 26 November to 11 December 2026.

 Important Instructions for SSC GD PET PST 2026 
 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 for candidates shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST). The admit card was released on 12 November 2026 on the SSC Central Region's official website. Candidates appearing for the physical tests can download their hall tickets online using their Registration Number and Date of Birth.
 According to the official notification, the SSC GD Physical Test will be conducted by the Central Reserve Police Force starting on November 26, 2026. A total of 197408 participants have been selected to move on to the PET or PST phase. For the SSF positions, 15,782 women, 1,81,251 men, and 375 men were shortlisted. Before proceeding to further recruitment phases, they would be asked to take the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) through the nodal CAPF/CRPF.

 How to Download SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates can follow the steps given below to download their SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 from the official website:
 Visit the SSC Central Region's official website at ssccr.gov.in.
 Navigate to the Admit Card section on the homepage.
 Find the SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 download link.
 Click on the available admit card link.
 Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
 Submit the login details to access your admit card.
 Check the details mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Download and print the admit card for future reference.
 Candidates preparing for the SSC GD examination can refer to the SSC GD Syllabus to check subject-wise topics, important chapters, and the complete syllabus for effective exam preparation.

 Important Instructions for SSC GD PET PST 2026
 Candidates appearing for the physical tests should follow the instructions mentioned on their admit cards. Some important points to remember are:
 Carry a printed copy of the SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 to the examination centre.
 Carry a valid photo ID proof along with the admit card.
 Reach the examination venue as per the reporting time mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Read all the physical test guidelines carefully before appearing.
 Follow the instructions provided by the examination authorities.
 Keep the admit card safe until the completion of the recruitment process.
 Candidates appearing for the SSC GD examination should check the SSC GD Eligibility Criteria to understand the required educational qualifications, age limit, physical standards, and category-wise eligibility conditions.
